name: supabase
title: Supabase
description: Rows of one Supabase table, over PostgREST. The row's primary key is the record's identity, so editing a row in Supabase updates the record in place. The API key is Flowpad's to hold, never a field on this form.

project_url.label: Project URL
project_url.hint: Supabase → Project Settings → Data API → Project URL. This names WHICH Supabase project the source serves. A self-hosted PostgREST gateway works too.

table.label: Table
table.hint: One source reads one table. Pick from what the key can see, or type the name. Watching two tables? Add two sources.

db_schema.label: Schema
db_schema.hint: Only a schema exposed in Data API settings can be read. Defaults to public.

id_column.label: Key column
id_column.hint: The column whose value identifies a row. Get this wrong and edits mint new records instead of updating them.

order_column.label: Newest-first column
order_column.hint: What 'newest' means here, and where a record's date comes from. Leave empty to order by the key column.

title_column.label: Title column
title_column.hint: Which column names the record. Left empty, the source takes title / name / subject / email if the row has one.

columns.label: Columns
columns.hint: A PostgREST select list: id,company_name,status — or an embed such as id,owner(name). Defaults to every column.

filters.label: Filters
filters.hint: PostgREST filters, one per line: status=eq.new, score=gte.80. All of them must hold.

max_rows.label: Rows per pass
max_rows.hint: The newest N rows each pass. A ceiling, not a queue: a table that grows by more than this between passes leaves its tail unread.
